approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Parse every exact RFC Message-ID token in In-Reply-To without persisting raw identifiers or inferring semantic relationships.
Reuse the existing local hash and deterministic email-thread index; add no dependency, model call or mailbox access.
title: Multi-parent email thread identifiers
objective: Preserve every exact hashed Message-ID token from multi-value In-Reply-To headers so deterministic email thread review does not split related messages.
